prefix: Photorealistic live-action sci-fi film shot, real human actors, cinematic lighting, 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, no cartoon, no on-screen text, no subtitles. The woman in the reference image is AyShe: keep her exact face. AyShe: strikingly beautiful young woman of about twenty, long loose silky jet-black hair, large dark brown eyes, light olive skin, fitted white-silver spacesuit with a glowing blue "23" badge on the chest. All spoken dialogue is in Turkish with natural native Turkish pronunciation and matching lip movement.

shots.03: Close-up through frosted glass: AyShe lies asleep with eyes closed inside a frost-covered cryo capsule marked with a glowing blue number 23. Frost slowly cracks across the glass, soft blue light pulses, her eyelids tremble. Silence, only a low hum and ice cracking.
shots.04: The cryo capsule lid slides open in a cloud of cold vapor. AyShe opens her eyes, dazed and confused, takes a deep breath. A small display beside her reads 201. She whispers in Turkish: "Neredeyim? Ben... kimim?"
shots.05: AyShe slowly sits up in the open capsule, mist around her, and stares at the small glowing display showing the number 201. She says in Turkish, stunned: "İki yüz bir yıl mı?"
shots.06: A small glowing turquoise orb floats down and hovers in front of AyShe's face, lighting her skin. The orb speaks with a soft warm female voice in Turkish: "Günaydın AyShe. Ya da iyi geceler... Burada saatler biraz karışıktır." AyShe watches it, surprised.
shots.07: AyShe looks at the glowing turquoise orb floating beside her and asks softly in Turkish: "AyShe... Benim adım bu mu?" The orb pulses and answers with a soft warm female voice in Turkish: "Evet. Ben Pusula."
shots.08: AyShe rises to her feet beside the open capsule in the blue-lit crystal chamber. The turquoise orb circles her once and drifts toward a glowing doorway, speaking with a soft female voice in Turkish: "Seni 201 yıldır bekliyorum. Kalk hadi, sana göstermem gereken bir dünya var."
shots.09: AyShe steps out of the chamber onto the edge of a floating continent in deep space; giant waterfalls flow upward into a violet and turquoise sky, distant galaxies above. She stares in awe and says in Turkish: "Burası... Dünya değil." Slow crane shot.
shots.10: Wide shot: AyShe stands on a cliff of the floating continent, the small turquoise orb beside her, nebula sky above. The orb speaks with a soft female voice in Turkish: "Elyra evrenlerin arasındaki boşlukta durur. Hiçbir haritada yoktur."
shots.11: AyShe walks slowly through a grey, lifeless crystal forest with drifting dust, the turquoise orb beside her. She asks sadly in Turkish: "Peki neden her şey bu kadar... ölü?" The orb answers softly in a female voice in Turkish: "Çünkü seni bekliyordu."
shots.12: AyShe enters a circle of ancient stone pillars carved with the number 23. She raises her palm: a glowing blue 23 appears on her skin. She whispers in Turkish: "Yirmi üç... Her yerde bu sayı var." Camera orbits around her, symbols flicker.
shots.13: A column of white light bursts up from the center of the stone circle. A tall elderly guardian with long silver hair and beard, pale glowing eyes and a robe woven of light materializes. He says in a deep calm male voice in Turkish: "Sonunda geldin, yirmi üçüncü." AyShe asks in Turkish: "Sen kimsin?"
shots.14: The tall elderly silver-bearded guardian in a robe of light speaks to AyShe, light particles floating between them. Deep calm male voice in Turkish: "Ben Taran, Elyra'nın bekçisi. 2099'da Dünya ölürken yirmi üç kişi uykuya yatırıldı." Subtle push-in on AyShe listening.
shots.15: A glowing DNA double helix rotates slowly in the air between AyShe and the silver-bearded guardian. AyShe asks in Turkish: "Neden ben?" The guardian answers in a deep calm male voice in Turkish: "Senin kromozomların hatırlıyor. Bu kıtayı uyandıracak olan sensin."
shots.16: AyShe places her palm on the trunk of a dead grey crystal tree; a wave of golden-blue light spreads from her hand into the trunk and roots, the crystals start to glow with color. She whispers in Turkish: "Canlanıyor..." The turquoise orb answers softly in a female voice in Turkish: "Hayır AyShe. Uyanıyor. Tıpkı senin gibi."
shots.17: Sweeping aerial shot: a wave of light races across the whole crystal forest to the horizon, 22 bright lights ignite one by one in the distance. The orb says softly in Turkish: "Yirmi iki kapsül daha uyanıyor." Close on AyShe, calm and hopeful, she says in Turkish: "Demek yalnız değilim."
shots.18: Close-up of AyShe at dusk, the forest glowing behind her. A faint crackling radio voice of a young man is heard in Turkish: "...beni duyan var mı..." She turns her head sharply toward the sound. Slow fade to black.
